units.source_text: 八月二十过后，有一天黄昏，夜色已深，明月未出，天空中只有星光闪烁。

en.t: After the twentieth day of the eighth month had passed, one evening, the night had grown deep, the bright moon had not yet risen, and only starlight shimmered in the sky.

units.source_text: 夜风掠过松梢，其音催人哀思。

en.t: The night wind swept over the tips of the pines, and its sound stirred sorrowful thoughts.

units.source_text: 常陆亲王家的小姐谈起父亲在世时的情况，不免流下泪来。

en.t: The young lady of Prince Hitachi's household spoke of the days when her father was still alive, and could not help shedding tears.

units.source_text: 大辅命妇觉得这正是个好机会了。

en.t: Taifu no Myobu thought this was just the right opportunity.

units.source_text: 大概是她通知源氏公子的吧，他照例偷偷摸摸地来到。

en.t: She had probably sent word to Prince Genji, for he arrived stealthily, as he usually did.

units.source_text: 月亮渐渐离开山顶，照明了这荒宅里的残垣败壁，小姐看了不免伤心。

en.t: The moon gradually rose clear of the mountaintop and lit the broken walls and ruined fences of the desolate house, and the young lady could not help feeling sad at the sight.
Taifu no Myobu then urged her to play the koto.
The sound of the koto was faint and subdued, yet it had a certain charm.

units.source_text: 但是这个轻佻的命妇觉得不够劲儿，她想：“弹得再时髦些才好。”

en.t: But this frivolous Myobu found it lacking in spirit and thought, "It would be better if she played in a more fashionable style."
